about: Phase 3 of 3, the mirror ('3 yes'). Runs only AFTER cred-rename-apply.yml has created the three standards titles (a fresh credential_reference_data.js lists Brakes (ASE A5 standards), Heating and Air Conditioning (ASE A7 standards) and Engine Performance (ASE A8 standards) as titles, not display names). Run earlier, the fold would create them first and turn Sam's renames into merges. The five credit-by-exam exhibits under the three cert titles, each a 2026-05-20 machine draft no person placed, move to the standards titles: MAPCXS-B3 (Chaffey, Brakes) to A5 standards; MAPCXS-BAAC (Chaffey, Basic Automotive Air Conditioning Systems) to A7 standards; MAPCBEN-EP (Engine Performance), MAPCxS-EPIA1 (Engine Performance I AUTO 018 Cx) and MAPCxS-EPIA (Engine Performance II AUTO 029 Cx) (Copper Mountain, San Diego Miramar) to A8 standards. Insert-only; each holds unless its kb/unified_titles.json entry is still that unreviewed draft. Two raw spellings under A7 and A8 in the reference ('Credit by Exam AUTO A7 Heating and Air Conditioning', '... A8 Engine Performance') carry the stale_kb_entry tag and no live exhibit, so they are left.
